streaks should be displayed pronominally in a location the user can see when 
they open the app. On the lesson selection activity, spaced repetition is indicated 
by the colour of the lesson, green indicates that the lesson has been recently 
revised and is okay to leave, whereas amber highlights that the lesson is ready 
to be returned to, respectively indicating safety and danger. To further aid the 
user, a less invasive text view displays how long until the lesson is ready. Card 
views in dark blue, highlight lessons or subtopics that are yet to be completed. 
All icons and views are cantered horizontally and vertically to follow the balance 
principle. 
The navigation bar is populated with custom icons, going from left to right, 
depicting a book, bulb, badge, trophy, and exit icon. The designed icons aim to 
signify their corresponding activity, and further enhancing usability by reducing 
text.
